lyrics.en: ※This translation is currently generated by AI. The refined version is coming soon!

lyrics.ja: 吸った向こう側の気配
lyrics.romaji: Sutta Mukou Gawa no Kehai
lyrics.en: The presence on the other side of what I breathed in
lyrics.zh: 吸入的彼端氣息

lyrics.ja: きっと目に映そう
lyrics.romaji: Kitto Me ni Utsusou
lyrics.en: I'll surely reflect it in my eyes
lyrics.zh: 一定會映照在眼中

lyrics.ja: 誤魔化さず言って言葉積み重ねよう
lyrics.romaji: Gomakasazu Itte Kotoba Tsumikasaneyou
lyrics.en: Let's speak without deception and pile up our words
lyrics.zh: 不敷衍地說出口，堆疊起話語吧

lyrics.ja: 高すぎる壁さえも跳んでしまうから
lyrics.romaji: Taka Sugiru Kabe Sae mo Tonde Shimau kara
lyrics.en: Because we'll leap over even walls that are too high
lyrics.zh: 因為連過高的牆也能跳過去

lyrics.ja: 通り抜けたってなにも楽しくないって
lyrics.romaji: Toorinuketa tte Nani mo Tanoshikunai tte
lyrics.en: That passing through isn't fun at all
lyrics.zh: 就算穿過去了也一點都不有趣

lyrics.ja: Never enough 君が教えてくれていたんだ
lyrics.romaji: Never Enough Kimi ga Oshiete Kurete Ita n Da
lyrics.en: Never enough—you were teaching me that
lyrics.zh: Never enough，是你一直教會我的

lyrics.ja: Ah, 夢を散々掛け合わせ
lyrics.romaji: Ah, Yume wo Sanzan Kakeawase
lyrics.en: Ah, multiplying dreams over and over
lyrics.zh: Ah，將夢想無數次相乘

lyrics.ja: 時に so, so 間違って
lyrics.romaji: Toki ni So, So Machigatte
lyrics.en: Sometimes making so, so many mistakes
lyrics.zh: 有時 so, so 地犯錯

lyrics.ja: それも laugh, laugh 気にせずに
lyrics.romaji: Sore mo Laugh, Laugh Ki ni Sezu ni
lyrics.en: Even that—laugh, laugh—without worrying
lyrics.zh: 那也 laugh, laugh 毫不在意

lyrics.ja: 何度でも挑もう だって I know myself
lyrics.romaji: Nando demo Idamou Datte I Know Myself
lyrics.en: Let's challenge it again and again—because I know myself
lyrics.zh: 無論多少次都去挑戰，因為 I know myself

lyrics.ja: 意味のない評価で世界比べないで
lyrics.romaji: Imi no Nai Hyouka de Sekai Kurabenaide
lyrics.en: Don't compare the world with meaningless evaluations
lyrics.zh: 別用毫無意義的評價來比較世界

lyrics.ja: 叶えたい本音はすべてを包み込む太陽
lyrics.romaji: Kanaetai Honne ha Subete wo Tsutsumikomu Taiyou
lyrics.en: The true feelings I want to fulfill are a sun that embraces everything
lyrics.zh: 想實現的真心話，是包覆一切的太陽

lyrics.ja: いっそ好き放題上を目指して 立ちはだかる壁を登って
lyrics.romaji: Isso Suki Houdai Ue wo Mezashite Tachihadakaru Kabe wo Nobotte
lyrics.en: Rather, aim upward as freely as you like, climb the walls that stand in the way
lyrics.zh: 乾脆隨心所欲地以高處為目標，攀上阻擋在前的高牆

lyrics.ja: 刻んでいきたいな そして次に臨む越えたいあの未来
lyrics.romaji: Kizande Ikitai na Soshite Tsugi ni Nozomu Koetai Ano Mirai
lyrics.en: I want to keep engraving it, and then face the next one—that future I want to surpass
lyrics.zh: 想持續銘刻下去，然後迎接下一次，想超越的那個未來

lyrics.ja: 想像したら鼓動が聞こえたんだ
lyrics.romaji: Souzou Shitara Kodou ga Kikoeta n Da
lyrics.en: When I imagined it, I could hear my heartbeat
lyrics.zh: 一想像，就聽見了心跳

lyrics.ja: 作り込んだ道なんて全部従わず行こう
lyrics.romaji: Tsukurikonda Michi Nante Zenbu Shitagawazu Ikou
lyrics.en: Let's go without obeying any of the pre-made paths
lyrics.zh: 那些精心鋪好的路，全都不遵從地走吧

lyrics.ja: 響く音のまま心が赴くまま
lyrics.romaji: Hibiku Oto no Mama Kokoro ga Omomuku Mama
lyrics.en: Just as the sound resounds, just as the heart goes
lyrics.zh: 隨著迴響的聲音，隨著心的方向

lyrics.ja: ずっと君なら君なら一緒になんでも築ける
lyrics.romaji: Zutto Kimi Nara Kimi Nara Issho ni Nandemo Kizukeru
lyrics.en: If it's you, if it's you, we can build anything together
lyrics.zh: 只要是你，只要是你，就能一起打造任何事物

lyrics.ja: 躓いて視界が何も見えなくなっても
lyrics.romaji: Tsumazuite Shikai ga Nani mo Mienaku Natte mo
lyrics.en: Even if I stumble and can't see anything
lyrics.zh: 即使跌倒，視野中什麼也看不見

lyrics.ja: 振り向いて笑えるそんな場所がある
lyrics.romaji: Furimuite Waraeru Sonna Basho ga Aru
lyrics.en: There's a place where I can turn around and laugh
lyrics.zh: 有個能回頭微笑的地方

lyrics.ja: ただ楽しもう
lyrics.romaji: Tada Tanoshimou
lyrics.en: Let's just have fun
lyrics.zh: 就只是享受吧

lyrics.ja: 夢を散々掛け合わせ
lyrics.romaji: Yume wo Sanzan Kakeawase
lyrics.en: Multiplying dreams over and over
lyrics.zh: 將夢想無數次相乘

lyrics.ja: 時に so, so 間違って
lyrics.romaji: Toki ni So, So Machigatte
lyrics.en: Sometimes making so, so many mistakes
lyrics.zh: 有時 so, so 地犯錯

lyrics.ja: それも laugh, laugh 気にせずに
lyrics.romaji: Sore mo Laugh, Laugh Ki ni Sezu ni
lyrics.en: Even that—laugh, laugh—without worrying
lyrics.zh: 那也 laugh, laugh 毫不在意

lyrics.ja: 何度でも挑もう いつも be yourself
lyrics.romaji: Nando demo Idamou Itsumo Be Yourself
lyrics.en: Let's challenge it again and again—always be yourself
lyrics.zh: 無論多少次都去挑戰，永遠 be yourself

lyrics.ja: 試さないとほら何も始まらない
lyrics.romaji: Tamesanai to Hora Nani mo Hajimaranai
lyrics.en: If you don't try, look—nothing will begin
lyrics.zh: 不試試看的話，你看，什麼都不會開始

lyrics.ja: 些細な勇気で明日を変えるまでもっと
lyrics.romaji: Sasai na Yuuki de Ashita wo Kaeru made Motto
lyrics.en: With the smallest courage, until we change tomorrow—more
lyrics.zh: 用微小的勇氣，直到改變明天，更加

lyrics.ja: 意味のない評価で世界比べないで
lyrics.romaji: Imi no Nai Hyouka de Sekai Kurabenaide
lyrics.en: Don't compare the world with meaningless evaluations
lyrics.zh: 別用毫無意義的評價來比較世界

lyrics.ja: 叶えたい本音はすべてを包み込む太陽
lyrics.romaji: Kanaetai Honne ha Subete wo Tsutsumikomu Taiyou
lyrics.en: The true feelings I want to fulfill are a sun that embraces everything
lyrics.zh: 想實現的真心話，是包覆一切的太陽

lyrics.ja: いっそ好き放題上を目指して 立ちはだかる壁を登って
lyrics.romaji: Isso Suki Houdai Ue wo Mezashite Tachihadakaru Kabe wo Nobotte
lyrics.en: Rather, aim upward as freely as you like, climb the walls that stand in the way
lyrics.zh: 乾脆隨心所欲地以高處為目標，攀上阻擋在前的高牆

lyrics.ja: 刻んでいきたいな そして次に臨む越えたいあの未来
lyrics.romaji: Kizande Ikitai na Soshite Tsugi ni Nozomu Koetai Ano Mirai
lyrics.en: I want to keep engraving it, and then face the next one—that future I want to surpass
lyrics.zh: 想持續銘刻下去，然後迎接下一次，想超越的那個未來

lyrics.ja: 抱こう壮大な未来
lyrics.romaji: Dakou Soudai na Mirai
lyrics.en: Let's embrace the grand future
lyrics.zh: 擁抱壯闊的未來吧
